nodes.label: Entity-Relationship Diagram (all modules)
nodes.rationale: The ERD is the contract migrations follow; tables are built per module in their step.

nodes.label: Partial Unique Index table_sessions_one_open_per_table
nodes.rationale: Opening a second tab fails at the database even if two tablets tap at the same moment.

nodes.label: Schedule Overlap Exclusion Constraint (btree_gist)
nodes.rationale: Compares real time ranges, so overlapping shifts across midnight are rejected by the database.

nodes.label: Revenue, Purchases, COGS, OpEx and Payroll Separation
nodes.norm_label: revenue, purchases, cogs, opex and payroll separation
nodes.rationale: Each figure has exactly one source table. No Product purchases or Salaries expense categories; advances are not expenses; cash drawer movements never in P&L.

nodes.norm_label: anti-goals (bill paid without payments, history-altering price changes, double-counted profit)

nodes.label: Payments Design (session-level, close only in PaymentService)
nodes.norm_label: payments design (session-level, close only in paymentservice)
nodes.rationale: Payments attach to the session; one transaction locks the session, recomputes totals, inserts the payment and closes when paid >= net total. No other code path closes a session.

nodes.label: Table Status vs Table Session Lifecycle
nodes.norm_label: table status vs table session lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Status is stored because the owner asked; drift is handled by a single writer (TableStatusService) called in the same transaction as session changes. Tradeoff: any other writer could desync.

nodes.label: Typography (Barlow, Barlow Semi Condensed)
nodes.rationale: Condensed signage type fits price boards and big totals; monospace headings read as a developer tool.

nodes.label: Bar-top-at-night Visual Direction (dark only)
nodes.rationale: Smoked oak surfaces, foam text, single lager amber accent; numbers set large like a bar price board.

nodes.label: Flat Tonal Depth (no shadows, no blur)
nodes.norm_label: flat tonal depth (no shadows, no blur)
nodes.rationale: Blur costs tablet frame rate and lowers contrast in dim light; shadows vanish on dark backgrounds.

nodes.label: Changes from UI UX Pro Max Generator Draft
nodes.norm_label: changes from ui ux pro max generator draft
nodes.rationale: Replaced generic slate/green, glassmorphism, Fira fonts, hover lifts and light-mode modal specs with warm, flat, touch-first choices.

nodes.label: Status Colors with Text Labels
nodes.rationale: Status never shown by color alone; tints or 4px left rule, never large fills. Green kept free for available/paid.

nodes.label: PaymentService (record, settleFreeBill)
nodes.rationale: Marks Paid only when recorded payments >= total, inside one transaction with lockForUpdate on the session; double submits ignored and overpay refused.

nodes.label: product_price_histories (append-only price/cost history)
nodes.rationale: Records initial values on create (old null) so a product's full price story is in one table; guarded by model and DB trigger.

nodes.label: Tab close when payments reach total (freeze totals, RCP, table freed)
nodes.norm_label: tab close when payments reach total (freeze totals, rcp, table freed)

nodes.label: Refund rule (closed tabs only, per payment, idempotent, no stock movement)
nodes.norm_label: refund rule (closed tabs only, per payment, idempotent, no stock movement)
nodes.rationale: Drinks served stay in COGS, so refunds move no stock (ARCHITECTURE 3.6).

nodes.label: ActivityLog Eloquent Append-Only Guard
nodes.rationale: updating/deleting throw LogicException before any SQL; second layer above the DB trigger.

nodes.label: ActivityLogger Injectable Service
nodes.rationale: Kept injectable instead of static: services already inject it and tests can swap it.

nodes.label: HasAuditedSoftDeletes Trait
nodes.rationale: Records who archived via activity log (<model>.archived/restored) instead of a deleted_by column: one source of truth for who.

nodes.label: Minimal activity_logs Table and ActivityLogger (Step 4)
nodes.rationale: Built in the auth step because the audit rule applies to login and account changes.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Rule (ActivityLogger::log, <module>.<verb>)
nodes.rationale: Log only changed fields in the same DB transaction; never log passwords, PINs or tokens.

nodes.label: HasAuditedSoftDeletes Soft-Delete Convention
nodes.rationale: Query-builder delete()/forceDelete() skip model events, so only model delete()/restore() inside the service transaction are allowed; forceDelete() throws.

nodes.label: No Hard Deletes Rule
nodes.rationale: Financial, inventory, payroll and audit records use soft deletes, voids, reversals or archival; corrections are new records.

nodes.label: Removed Breeze Features (registration, reset, verification, account delete)
nodes.norm_label: removed breeze features (registration, reset, verification, account delete)
nodes.rationale: No mail configured and no hard deletes; change-my-password kept.

nodes.norm_label: open questions (hosting, senior/pwd, cutoff, payroll rules, precision)

nodes.label: YANGS Architecture and Database Design

nodes.norm_label: phase 1 deviations (breeze not fortify, username login, kebab-case permissions)
nodes.rationale: Breeze was the owner's choice; audit log built early because the audit rule applied to auth actions; design system replaced with warm oak and amber.

nodes.label: Versioned REST API under /api/v1
nodes.rationale: Designed so a future mobile app can use the same backend.

nodes.label: Username Login (lowercase unique, email optional)
nodes.rationale: Bar staff may have no email.

nodes.label: Owner Decisions (2026-11-18 Q&A)
nodes.rationale: VAT off by default, manual discounts, allow negative stock and never block service, PIN approval on same device, no printer yet (80mm on-screen/PDF).

nodes.label: VAT (inclusive, frozen on session at close)
nodes.norm_label: vat (inclusive, frozen on session at close)
nodes.rationale: Freezing rate and amount means toggling VAT later never changes past bills.

nodes.label: Money Precision: decimal(12,2) totals, decimal(14,6) unit costs
nodes.norm_label: money precision: decimal(12,2) totals, decimal(14,6) unit costs
nodes.rationale: Per-ml cost cannot be stored at 2 decimals without error on every shot; all math in bcmath, rounded half-up when it becomes an amount.

nodes.label: Recipe Components (case-to-bottle, bottle-to-shot)
nodes.rationale: One recipe table covers bottles, buckets, shots and cocktails, so no separate conversion and bundle features. Base unit plus inventory_units factors.

nodes.label: Stock Deducted on Send Round
nodes.rationale: Matches bar reality (drinks leave the shelf when ordered); deduct at payment would leave stock wrong all night. Never block on negative stock; cancels ask return-to-stock.

nodes.label: Tab Actions: Move, Merge, Split (child sessions)
nodes.norm_label: tab actions: move, merge, split (child sessions)
nodes.rationale: Child sessions chosen over payment allocations so payments, receipts and totals need no special cases. Only allowed before any payment.

nodes.label: Moving Weighted Average Cost (WAC) and Cost Snapshots
nodes.norm_label: moving weighted average cost (wac) and cost snapshots
nodes.rationale: FIFO needs cost layers for no real benefit in a bar; standard cost drifts. WAC is usual for small F&B. Known limit: items sold at negative stock use old average.

nodes.label: Cancel vs Void (before vs after payment)
nodes.norm_label: cancel vs void (before vs after payment)
nodes.rationale: Before payment the line is marked cancelled; after payment units are voided as separate append-only records. Deviates from ARCHITECTURE 3.3's single void.
